reserve_mix.note: From the attested 2026-06-30 reserves report (all fiat-denominated Tether tokens). U.S. Treasury bills are shown as ≤ 93 days, but Tether states only a weighted-average maturity under 90 days. Overnight and term reverse repo are repo; non-US Treasury bills are other_tbills; corporate bonds, public equities and other investments are other.

regulatory.note: No Tether entity or USDT white paper appears in ESMA's interim MiCA register (e-money token issuers file, last modified 2026-10-16; the other register files were also searched). This is an absence in the register, not a regulator statement.

The Act is not in force yet: it takes effect on the earlier of 2027-01-18 (18 months after enactment) or 120 days after final implementing regulations, and only proposed rules from the federal regulators were found as of 2026-10-20. The issuer is organised in El Salvador; the Act defines a foreign payment stablecoin issuer as one organised or domiciled in a foreign country. No source was found on a USDT application to become a permitted issuer.

redemption.channel: direct redemption with Tether International through the Tether website (app.tether.to), paid to a bank account in the customer's name
redemption.eligibility: KYC-verified customers only; U.S. persons are excluded except eligible contract participants agreed by Tether; a 150 USDT verification fee applies
redemption.fee: the greater of US$1,000 or 0.1% of the tokens redeemed

regulatory.note: Listed in ESMA's interim MiCA register of e-money token issuers (ACPR, France; authorisation notified 2024-07-01). The ACPR register shows Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS as an electronic money institution (no. 17788) since 2024-07-01. It covers USDC issued in the EEA; Circle Internet Financial, LLC issues outside the EEA.

The Act is not in force yet: it takes effect on the earlier of 2027-01-18 (18 months after enactment) or 120 days after final implementing regulations; only proposed rules from the federal regulators were found as of 2026-10-20. Circle states that USDC is regulated as stored value or prepaid access under U.S. state money transmission laws.

redemption.channel: Circle Mint account (Standard or Express redemption)
redemption.eligibility: Circle Mint account holders in good standing in supported jurisdictions; holders without an account must open one; KYC is required
redemption.fee: Per the USDC/EURC Redemption Structure page, part of the fee schedule the Terms reference: Standard redemption: no fee charged by Circle (processed within two business days, plus bank settlement time). Express redemption: 5 bps on the gross amount, reducible by Net Mint Redemption Credits of 25%, 75% or 100%. This structure applies on or after 2026-10-19.

redemption.channel: MiCA Redemption Policy, outside Circle Mint (EEA holders, with Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS)
redemption.eligibility: all holders have a right of redemption at par value at any time, subject to the policy conditions (KYC/KYT, a bank account)
redemption.fee: at par value under the policy; third-party fees may occur on the USD payment to the bank account
